title: Quantized model is not working properly when CUBLAS is ON
body: When I use quantized Whisper models with full GPU CUBLAS, the transcription is nonsense—all kinds of signs appear instead of words.

symptoms_visible: With full GPU CUBLAS enabled, quantized Whisper models produce nonsense and symbols instead of recognized words.
N0.label: N0 quantized CUDA transcription failure reported

symptoms_visible: After synchronizing the latest ggml from llama.cpp, quantized Whisper output with CUDA is still nonsense, and talk-llama behaves the same way.
N1_x.label: N1_x ggml synchronization aftermath

symptoms_visible: Every quantization mode I tested produces incorrect output with CUDA, while FP16 works properly.
The quantized-model logits are near zero, and my dumped embd_enc values differ significantly between CUDA and CPU; that difference is absent in FP16.
The same quantized TinyLlama model works properly in llama.cpp main.
N1.label: N1 CUDA-specific quantized behavior characterized

symptoms_visible: After applying the provided CMakeLists.txt fragment and rebuilding, quantized models produce correct output with CUDA.
N2.label: N2 proposed build configuration verified

symptoms_visible: Quantized Whisper models recognize text correctly with full GPU CUBLAS after rebuilding with the corrected CUDA architecture configuration.
N_terminal.label: terminal resolved

solution.intent: Synchronize whisper.cpp with the latest ggml implementation from llama.cpp in case an outdated shared CUDA implementation is responsible.
solution.concrete_example: Pull the latest ggml sources from llama.cpp into whisper.cpp, rebuild with CUBLAS, and retry the quantized model.

edges.comment: Reporter bobqianic c1: the latest ggml from llama.cpp had already been synchronized, but both talk-llama and Whisper continued producing incorrect quantized output.

question_patterns: What have you already tried, and what happened after rebuilding?
Have you compared this against the current shared ggml code?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: I synchronized the latest ggml from llama.cpp, but the behavior stayed the same. Both talk-llama and Whisper behave identically.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: Updating to the latest ggml made the quantized Whisper model work correctly with CUDA.

question_patterns: Does this affect one quantization format or every format you tested, and how does FP16 behave?
Can you compare the affected models on the CUDA and CPU backends?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: I tested Q8_0, Q6_K, Q5_K, Q5_1, Q5_0, Q4_K, Q4_1, Q4_0, Q3_K, and Q2_K. None works properly on CUDA. Their outputs differ significantly between CUDA and CPU, while FP16 works properly and does not show that difference.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: The same quantized models produce identical nonsense on both CPU and CUDA, and FP16 is also incorrect.
Only Q5_1 and Q4_0 were tested, but both fail on CUDA while FP16 remains correct.

question_patterns: What do intermediate values or output logits look like when comparing CUDA with CPU?
Can you dump an intermediate tensor from both backends and describe the difference?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: The output logits of the quantized models are near zero. I dumped embd_enc and found that the CUDA results differ significantly from the CPU results.

question_patterns: Does a quantized model work in llama.cpp main on the same setup?
Can you compare with another program using the current ggml CUDA backend?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: Yes. tinyllama-1.1b-chat-v0.3.Q4_0.gguf works properly when I run it with main in llama.cpp.

edges.comment: Reporter bobqianic c1-c5 and c7 supplied the backend comparison, intermediate values, exhaustive quantization tests, and llama.cpp control result. The opening symptom originated with participant1 and is folded into the affected-user side; these diagnostics describe bobqianic's own tests.

question_patterns: After updating ggml, which formats and backends still show the problem?
Does FP16 behave the same way as the quantized formats?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: All the quantization modes I tested still fail on CUDA and differ significantly from CPU. FP16 works correctly.

question_patterns: Can you compare logits and an intermediate tensor between CPU and CUDA?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: The quantized logits are near zero, and the dumped embd_enc values from CUDA differ significantly from the CPU values.

question_patterns: Does the same class of quantized model work in llama.cpp main?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: Yes, the Q4_0 TinyLlama model works properly with llama.cpp main.

edges.comment: Recovery from the failed ggml-sync attempt using bobqianic's c1-c5 and c7 diagnostics. This keeps the failed-attempt fact while moving to the CUDA-specific comparison that enabled the successful test.

question_patterns: Can you apply the provided CMakeLists.txt fragment, rebuild, and report whether the quantized output changes?
Please test the proposed build-file change and tell me whether recognition becomes correct.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: I rebuilt with the provided fragment, but the quantized output is still nonsense.
It works after a clean rebuild with the provided fragment.

edges.comment: Maintainer slaren c8-c10 supplied a candidate CMakeLists.txt fragment; reporter bobqianic c11 tested it and reported only 'Wow, it works!'. This is a handler-initiated build/configuration measurement, so the raw result remains a clarification rather than embedding the diagnosis in the user's answer.

solution.intent: Correct whisper.cpp's CMake CUDA architecture configuration by supplying the ggml default architecture list when it is not overridden and applying that list to the whisper target, then rebuild.
solution.concrete_example: In the GGML_CUDA_SOURCES section, replace the original first set_property with logic that defaults GGML_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES to 52 61 70 when it is not defined, prints the selected architectures, and sets CUDA_ARCHITECTURES on the whisper target. Reconfigure and rebuild with CUBLAS.
solution.inference_hint: The reporter supplied backend comparisons and confirmed that the proposed build-file fragment worked. Concluding that whisper.cpp's CUDA architecture configuration, rather than quantization itself or the shared ggml CUDA implementation, caused the failure is the maintainer-side inference supported by that test.

edges.comment: Resolution from slaren c8-c10 and bobqianic c11: changing the CUDA architecture setup in CMakeLists.txt restored correct behavior on the affected reporter's system. No separate landing or release-management outcome was stated in the thread.

satisfaction_conditions: Must identify the accepted root cause as whisper.cpp's CMake CUDA architecture configuration, grounded in the CUDA-versus-CPU and FP16-versus-quantized comparisons plus the successful test of the proposed CMakeLists.txt fragment.
Must recommend configuring the default GGML CUDA architectures when not overridden and assigning them to the whisper target, followed by a rebuild.
Must not treat synchronizing the latest ggml from llama.cpp as the fix; the reporter already tried it and the failure remained.
Must not diagnose quantization formats generally as broken, because the same quantized TinyLlama model worked in llama.cpp and the failure was specific to whisper.cpp's CUDA path.
Must require or rely on the affected user verifying correct quantized output after rebuilding before declaring the issue resolved.

persona_hint.experience_level: Highly technical contributor comfortable synchronizing ggml sources, rebuilding CUDA projects, testing many quantization formats, dumping tensors, and comparing logits across backends.
persona_hint.communication_style: Direct and investigative; posts concise status updates, concrete model names, backend comparisons, intermediate-value observations, and quick confirmation after a successful test.
